gates.says: all 4 of this quiz's discriminating readings held and each was taken over the question as it stands

recorded.prompt:q-oomkilled:b: Read the page and each keyed question. For every wrong option, say whether a passage of the page rules it out, and quote or name that passage.
recorded.pass:q-oomkilled:b: an independent reader (43-jvm-internals q3), never the author
recorded.outcome:q-oomkilled:b: ruled out: The page's own memory list treats -Xmx as bounding the heap total ("Heap (-Xmx): Java objects and arrays") and attributes overage to non-heap components (Metaspace, thread stacks, code cache, direct buffers, native memory), not to the young generation being sized on top of -Xmx.
recorded.prompt:q-oomkilled:c: Read the page and each keyed question. For every wrong option, say whether a passage of the page rules it out, and quote or name that passage.
recorded.pass:q-oomkilled:c: an independent reader (43-jvm-internals q3), never the author
recorded.outcome:q-oomkilled:c: ruled out: Nothing on the page describes GC copying data into memory reserved beyond -Xmx; the stated cause is "The JVM uses more memory than just the heap (Metaspace, thread stacks, direct memory, native memory)".
recorded.prompt:q-histogram:a: Read the page and each keyed question. For every wrong option, say whether a passage of the page rules it out, and quote or name that passage.
recorded.pass:q-histogram:a: an independent reader (43-jvm-internals q3), never the author
recorded.outcome:q-histogram:a: ruled out: The page describes histo:live as forcing a Full GC ("BAD: Forces a Full GC in production jmap -histo:live <pid>"), not writing a heap dump; heap dumps are a separate, explicitly distinct operation ("jmap -dump").
recorded.prompt:q-histogram:c: Read the page and each keyed question. For every wrong option, say whether a passage of the page rules it out, and quote or name that passage.
recorded.pass:q-histogram:c: an independent reader (43-jvm-internals q3), never the author
recorded.outcome:q-histogram:c: ruled out: The page never says histo:live changes the collector; it only says it "Forces a Full GC in production," using whatever collector is already configured.
